title: Ashbury Rewards Frequent-Guest Reduction on Room Reservations Extra-Person Charges
content:
## Recognition term

When an extra-person charge is added to a Room Reservations reservation, a guest whose Ashbury Rewards account shows at least 6 stays credited in the twelve months before the day of handling, each stay night-credit posting counting as one stay whatever its nights and a posting dated on or before the same calendar date twelve months earlier being outside them, pays the charge less the frequent-guest share of 40%; one whose account shows at least 3 such stays pays it less the regular-guest share of 20%; any other guest pays it in full (0% off).

## Counting the stays

- **What counts:** night-credit postings for stay nights on the guest's Ashbury Rewards account — one posting is one stay, whether it credited one night or many. Other postings (points, co-brand annual night credits, reversals) are not stays.
- **The window:** the twelve months before the day of handling. A posting dated on, or before, the same calendar date twelve months earlier is outside the window.

| Day of handling (hypothetical) | Posting dated | Inside the window? |
|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2027 | 16 March 2026 | Yes |
| 15 March 2027 | 15 March 2026 | No — same calendar date twelve months earlier |
| 15 March 2027 | 2 February 2026 | No |

## Reduction by stays counted

| Stays counted | Share taken off the extra-person charge |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 40% |
| 3, 4 or 5 | 20% |
| 0, 1 or 2 | 0% |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** An extra-person charge of 50.00 for one night becomes 30.00 for a guest with 7 stays counted and 40.00 for a guest with 3; a guest with 2 stays pays the 50.00 in full.
